title: Appointment No-Show Prediction for a Dental Clinic
client_problem: The clinic lost about 18 appointment slots every week to patients who did not show up. Reception staff phoned every patient the day before, which took around two hours a day.
work_done: We built a small web tool that ranks the next day's appointments by the chance of a no-show. Reception now calls only the 15 highest-risk patients each afternoon. We also trained two reception staff to use it.
technical_approach: We trained a gradient boosting model on 14 months of anonymised appointment history. Features included booking lead time, past no-shows and appointment type. The model is retrained every Sunday night.
challenges: The appointment history had duplicate records from an old booking system migration. Patient names had to be removed before any data left the clinic.
results: Over the first 8 weeks, weekly no-shows fell from about 18 to 11. Daily reminder calls dropped from around two hours to 40 minutes.
